title: Kept statement
description: A statement as the evidence store keeps it, for a party to keep its own evidence (REQ-AUD-5) and for a checker outside the operator to check the log against (REQ-AUD-9, REQ-AUD-10). To check it against the stated entry that names it: recompute SHA-256 of the decoded salt followed by the decoded bytes and compare it with the entry's commitment; then read the bytes as the statement's envelope, check that its signature's scheme and key equal the entry's signed_with, and verify the signature over provider-role's signing input of the bytes, the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the envelope as received, without signature.value.

commitment.description: The commitment the stated entry names it by.

salt.description: The 32-byte salt it was committed with, base64url without padding.

bytes.description: The statement's bytes exactly as received, base64url without padding.
